Heads-up on a couple of things I'll call out in the review so Novacore can prep:

- Proxy placement: our recommendation is to colocate the proxy in the tenant runtime plane when tenant SLA requires sub-30ms tail latency. If Novacore prefers shared ingestion, we need to size the proxy pool to absorb peak concurrent KV lookups (I can share the sizing calc).
- KV cache replication: with local-reduce batch enabled, we see a modest increase in per-request CPU (20–30%) due to merge windows; however network traffic for replication drops ~40% because most lookups are satisfied locally. This will affect staging CPU headroom more than egress bandwidth.
- TLS termination: recommend mutual TLS between control-plane and proxy; control-plane cert rotation is supported via our KMS plugin (see slide 2 of the schematic for the flow).

I'll bring the micro-benchmark numbers and a short table mapping batch sizes -> expected P50/P95.

-Jonas
